identity.name: ROYAL ORCHID HOTELS LTD
identity.industry: Hospitality / Premium Lifestyle & Upscale Hotel Chains

summary.oneLiner: Royal Orchid delivered disciplined 10.7% YoY revenue growth driven by ICONIQA Mumbai’s ahead-of-schedule launch, but Q2 PAT was distorted by a one-time Ind AS charge of ₹6.35cr; the real story is the scalable asset-light model now validated with 388 new keys added and a clear path to triple portfolio by 2030.

one-line thesis: Royal Orchid delivered disciplined 10.7% YoY revenue growth driven by ICONIQA Mumbai’s ahead-of-schedule launch, but Q2 PAT was distorted by a one-time Ind AS charge of ₹6.35cr; the real story is the scalable asset-light model now validated with 388 new keys added and a clear path to triple portfolio by 2030.
financial scorecard: Revenue: +10.7% YoY to ₹86.8cr (ex-ICONIQA base grew ~5%); EBITDA: +7% YoY to ₹20.8cr; PAT (reported): ₹4.3cr (includes ₹8.35cr one-off: ₹2cr pre-op loss + ₹6.35cr Ind AS); PAT (normalized): ~₹12.65cr; Order book: 38 signed hotels (2 Crestoria, rest Regenta/Regenta Z); Net debt: ₹218cr lease liability (H1), ₹12-13cr cash outflow expected H2
guidance: Revenue growth: >15% FY27 (driven by ICONIQA full year + 38 new keys); Margin: EBITDA margin target 25%+ by FY27; Order inflow: 38 signed hotels to commission by 2027; Capex/commissioning: ₹150-200cr FY27 for 5 new revenue-share hotels (Gurgaon, Lucknow, North Goa, Crestoria, Regenta Z)
order book & pipeline: 38 signed hotels: 2 Crestoria (40 keys each), 1 Regenta Resort (Dodamarg), 1 Regenta (Gurgaon Sector 20, 120 keys), 1 Regenta (Lucknow, 172 keys), rest Regenta Z (40-60 keys each)
segment / subsidiary detail: ICONIQA Mumbai: 292 keys, ₹3cr revenue in Q2, ₹5cr OpEx, targeting ₹100cr+ ARR next year; Regenta: 70% occupancy, 54% managed segment occupancy; Regenta Z: franchise model, low capex, rapid scale; F&B: 40% of revenue, undergoing strategic revamp; Corporate/leisure mix: 60:40, domestic guests up 14k YoY
growth verticals / optionality: Franchise-led Regenta Z expansion (40-60 key hotels) enables 2x faster scaling than owned assets; potential M&A of weaker regional chains to accelerate footprint; F&B monetization via standalone concepts; international expansion via franchise model post-2027
margins & cost dynamics: Employee cost: ₹25cr/quarter (₹3cr from ICONIQA pre-op); rent cost: ₹5.7cr/quarter (ex-ICONIQA); ICONIQA OpEx: ₹4-4.5cr/month; EBITDA margin: 24% ex-ICONIQA, 20% consolidated; cost leverage expected as new hotels stabilize and AI reduces labor dependency
capex / expansion: ₹150-200cr FY27 for 5 new revenue-share hotels; no capex for ICONIQA (leased); Regenta Z capex <₹5cr/hotel; total capex FY26: ₹120cr (mostly for Bangalore renovations and ICONIQA fit-out)
capital allocation: Prioritizing franchise expansion (Regenta Z) over owned assets; debt used for lease commitments; no dividend policy stated; focus on cash ROCE >25%; no equity raise planned; F&B and tech investments funded from ops
risks & watch-items: Land-use delays (Goa renovation); wage inflation in hospitality labor; lease renegotiation risk for ICONIQA; occupancy volatility in Goa due to taxi regulations; competition from Marriott, IHG in upscale segment; Ind AS accounting distortion masking true cash flow
management quality / tone: Confident, execution-focused, and disciplined; repeated emphasis on speed, cost control, and asset-light scalability; management visibly proud of ICONIQA’s 11-month delivery; tone is long-term builder, not short-term speculator
non-obvious takeaways: ICONIQA’s ₹6.35cr Ind AS charge is a non-cash accounting distortion — actual cash outflow for lease is ₹0 in Q2 (rent-free period); the real cash flow strength is hidden in normalized PAT of ₹12.65cr; Regenta Z franchise model has near-zero capex and 3x faster ROI than owned hotels

themes.title: Hospitality & travel up-cycle
themes.need: Q1FY27 split hotels from airlines. INDHOTEL delivered a 17th consecutive record quarter - consolidated revenue INR 2,419cr (+15%), EBITDA INR 753cr at 31.1%, standalone occupancy jumping to 82% from 76% on a 41.8% standalone EBITDA margin, and asset-light management-fee income INR 168cr (+26%) - with management now framing the West-Asia war as a NET tailwind because outbound travel stays home; leisure RevPAR (Rajasthan/Goa) ran up high-20s. Airlines got the mirror image: INDIGO's EBITDAR margin collapsed from 28.0% to 15.6% on blended ATF of ~INR 140-150/litre versus INR 85-90 pre-war (fuel CASK +~80% YoY), leaving yield as the only defence. MHRIL shows domestic leisure premiumisation is real - Keystone average unit realisation +73% to INR 14.4 lakh on stable gross sales. LEMONTREE/CHALET/SAMHI/THELEELA ride the same occupancy-led room cycle; TRAVELFOOD/TBOTEK/DREAMFOLKS remain levered to airport PAX and B2B travel.
themes.driver: Occupancy-led (not rate-led) RevPAR compounding plus INDHOTEL's Ginger conversion cadence stepping 15->20->25->40 per quarter through FY27; for airlines the swing is INDIGO's guided Q2 PRASK growth of 'more than 25%' on flattish capacity against ATF cracks.
